outcome: Official experiment scoring and Development-Probe final assessment use independently inspectable execution evidence rather than candidate-produced conclusions, scores, or verdicts.
practical_value: A candidate cannot win or pass by declaring itself correct, and an operator can reconstruct every official result from the exact evidence the judge received.
stopping_condition: Flipping only a producer self-verdict cannot change ranking or final assessment; missing independent evidence cannot yield a positive verdict; equivalent observed behavior receives the same score; and every accepted verdict cites hash-bound evidence.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: Independent observations determine the official result while contradictory producer claims remain audit-only.
A producer claim cannot substitute for missing independently inspectable evidence.
